description: This file defines a base class 'BaseEmailLogger' for sending various types of email notifications related to user actions such as invitation, key creation, key rotation, and budget alerts. It includes methods for composing emails, retrieving user info, generating invitation links, and managing email templates and parameters.

classes.name: BaseEmailLogger
classes.description: A base class for sending email notifications related to user actions and budget alerts, with methods for composing emails, retrieving user info, and managing email templates.

methods.name: send_user_invitation_email
methods.description: Sends an invitation email to a user after they are invited to a team.

methods.name: send_key_created_email
methods.description: Sends an email notification after a user creates a new key.

methods.name: send_key_rotated_email
methods.description: Sends an email notification after a user rotates their key.

methods.name: send_soft_budget_alert_email
methods.description: Sends an email alert when the soft budget is crossed.

methods.name: send_max_budget_alert_email
methods.description: Sends an email alert when the maximum budget threshold is reached.

methods.name: budget_alerts
methods.description: Dispatches budget alert emails based on the specified alert type and user info, with caching to prevent duplicate alerts.

methods.name: _get_email_params
methods.description: Retrieves email parameters such as logo URL, support contact, and email subject template based on the email event type.

methods.name: _format_key_budget
methods.description: Formats the key budget value for display in emails.

methods.name: _lookup_user_email_from_db
methods.description: Looks up a user's email address from the database using their user ID.

methods.name: _get_invitation_link
methods.description: Generates an invitation link for a user, creating a new invitation if necessary.

methods.name: _is_prisma_client_available
methods.description: Checks if the Prisma client is available for database operations.

methods.name: _wait_for_invitation_creation
methods.description: Waits for any ongoing invitation creation process to complete.

methods.name: _get_or_create_invitation
methods.description: Retrieves an existing invitation or creates a new one for a user.

methods.name: _construct_invitation_link
methods.description: Constructs a URL for the invitation link with the invitation ID.
